_meta.what_this_is: What is known for this environment and this need, and how well. Not a judgement of safety, not a prediction for a condition without a test. Team computation from NASA PSI tables and quoted documents.

environment.label: Lunar base or pressurized rover
environment.caveat: The pressure range of this scenario reaches up to 85.8 kPa, above the 70.3 kPa (10.2 psi) of the challenge statement, so that tests set to 0.7 atm are inside it. The 17 tests counted for a need inside its oxygen and pressure ranges were recorded at 71.2 to 72.4 kPa, above 10.2 psi; the 9 tests inside the ranges recorded at 50.7 kPa are not counted for a need.

need.question: Under what heating, flow and aging conditions was smoke from this material characterised?
need.reading: A row of this need holds the conditions of a smoke test: material, air flow, aging time and the heating level (a target weight loss rate in the planned SAME matrix, SAMEEIRD.target; the heater resistance ratio Rt/R0 in SAME-R, SAMER.rtr0). No row holds a measured smoke property, so no test is counted for this need.

top_line.text: Not judged here. The PSI experimental tables hold no test counted for this need. Published results and caveats quoted for this need or for fire safety in general: 2 at the oxygen and pressure of this environment and 0 about one of its conditions; they are quotes, not tests. What has not been found in these sources is listed.

sentences.text: How NASA documents treat this question, as quoted items of the reference list: 10 criteria, requirements or definitions and 11 questions or research needs.

Of the 10 criteria, 0 state an oxygen and a pressure inside the ranges of this environment, 0 state at least one of its conditions and none outside, and 10 state no oxygen, pressure or gravity level that can be compared.
The questions and research needs are quoted from documents of their own dates; the list does not say what NASA considers open today.
The six needs are the team's construction, and which items are listed for a need is an AI reading of the items that was not checked by a person.

No test in the mapped PSI tables is counted for this need: no test meets every required condition, holds a value for at least one outcome variable of the need and comes from an investigation linked to the need by a supported purpose sentence of the investigators or of a NASA project document.

This environment covers 2 cells of the coverage grid (oxygen bin by pressure bin). Of the 5 cells one step away in oxygen or in pressure, 0 hold a counted test of this need matched by oxygen, by pressure or by both.

not_covered.area: Post-fire clean-up
not_covered.why: Fourth capability area in the NASA fire protection brief; the PSI tables hold no clean-up or atmosphere-recovery measurement.

not_covered.area: Extinguishing agent transport and distribution
not_covered.why: Listed as needed knowledge in NASA/CP-2003-212103; the PSI tables hold no agent-delivery measurement.

not_covered.area: Material flammability in partial gravity
not_covered.why: Named a major gap; every test in the PSI tables is a microgravity test.

not_covered.area: Toxic combustion products other than carbon monoxide (HCN, HCl, HF)
not_covered.why: Required monitoring targets; the PSI tables record carbon monoxide and carbon dioxide only.

not_covered.area: Fire signatures other than combustion gases and smoke: temperature rise, light and other radiation, pressure rise, acoustic waves
not_covered.why: Listed among the signatures detectors respond to; no standard variable of the pipeline (variables.json) holds one of them.

not_covered.area: Transport of fire precursors
not_covered.why: Named as inadequately known in NASA/CP-2003-212103; no standard variable holds a transport measurement.

not_covered.area: Smoke particle size and smoke detector response
not_covered.why: Published by the SAME investigators (SAME.sizes, SAME.detector); the PSI experimental tables of SAME and SAME-R hold the test conditions only.

not_covered.area: Combustion by-products of extinguishing agents
not_covered.why: Listed as needed knowledge (by-products of fires and agents; see also TB008.agent); the mapped tables hold no product reading for a test with an agent.

not_covered.area: Location of a fire in the vehicle
not_covered.why: Named among the initial conditions a response depends on; no standard variable holds where in a vehicle a fire is.

not_covered.area: Transfer of burning debris to adjacent materials
not_covered.why: Part of the Test 1 acceptance criterion; no standard variable holds it.

not_covered.area: Ignition-source control
not_covered.why: Named under prevention in the challenge statement (CH.pillars; read from a copy, not re-checked on the official page); the mapped tables hold igniter settings of single tests and nothing about ignition sources in a vehicle, and need P2 has no counted test.

not_covered.area: Heat release of a fire
not_covered.why: The record says the results 'are used in first order models and predictions of heat release in spacecraft fires'; no standard variable holds a heat release.

not_covered.area: Non-flaming and smoldering combustion
not_covered.why: Named as a gap by the prevention group of NASA/CP-2003-212103 (CP2003.prev.smolder) and in the organizing questions of 2004 (CP2004.flam.q7); no need of this file is about it, and no standard variable marks a test as non-flaming or smoldering.

not_covered.area: Background particulate and chemical species in the cabin
not_covered.why: First organizing question for fire signatures and detection (CP2004.det.q1); no need of this file is about it. The DAFT record (PSI-47) is in the catalogue: its objective field says 'The focus of DAFT / DAFT-2 was to mitigate the risk for the Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment (SAME).', and its table is one row per sampling session, which the pipeline does not map.

not_covered.area: From small-scale experiments to large-scale fires
not_covered.why: Organizing question 5 of 2004 (CP2004.flam.q5); the pipeline does not relate tests of different sample size to each other.

not_covered.area: Detector location and time to detection
not_covered.why: Named as knowledge that detection depends on (TB008.location); no standard variable holds a detector position or a time to detection.

not_covered.area: Flame spread over thermally thick versus thin materials
not_covered.why: Named by the prevention group (CP2003.prev.thickthin); the pipeline carries a sample thickness where the table gives one and does not class a test as thermally thick or thin.

not_covered.area: Flammability limit of liquid fuels as a prevention question
not_covered.why: The limiting oxygen index is named a principal objective of FLEX and tied to spacecraft fire safety (TP216046.loi; see also RG.droplet, FLEX.objective1). The team's scope 'solid' keeps the FLEX tests out of P1; they are counted for S1 only.

not_covered.area: Fire prevention as the stated focus of BRE (PSI-20)
not_covered.why: NASA documents name BRE as the ACME experiment focused on spacecraft fire prevention (ACME14.bre, RG.bre, ACME21.bre). This file links PSI-20 to S1 only, with verdict 'differs', and its table is one row per test day, so no test is counted.

not_covered.area: Ignition delay of the BASS-II PMMA rods
not_covered.why: Defined and reported by the investigators in the BASS-II Summary Report (BASS2TM.igndelay); the PSI-25 experimental table has no column for it, so need P2 has no counted test.
